decisions: Keep native key/type facts distinct from model identity and persistent selectors.
Read full native interface tables and paired uint64 counters without labels, addresses or packet content in the shared result.

Compare real values against independent fixed OS brackets and commit only outcomes/counts.
Keep the Windows potentially blocking API isolated from production until supervised collector integration; native targets remain disabled in the historical profile.
